text:
kai-marketing: Quick note  proposals to stop the inbox pileups during product launches. Need small changes to cadence + suppression.
emma-growth: Agreed. We lost engagement when launch + benchmark + webinar all landed in a week. What's the simplest fix?
owen-analytics: Short read: paid_trial_new=10,200; conference_leads=1,800. Overlap (>=2 sends in 6 days) ~12.3%. SQL used:
```sql
SELECT user_id, source, campaign, sent_at FROM email_events
WHERE sent_at BETWEEN '2026-03-01' AND '2026-03-31'
AND campaign IN ('welcome_v4','bench_report_v2','webinar_invite_v3')
ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 500;
```
mira-campaigns: Minimal changes: stagger benchmark to D8 for paid cohorts, D12 for conference leads; webinar -> D16 globally. Add suppression: do not send if opened_email_last_72h OR triggered_event('first_success') in 72h. Also exclude sales_contacted=true.
ben-sales: Confirming sales_contacted flag should be authoritative. If true, skip webinar and route to sales nurture. Add 24h buffer after any sales outreach.
kai-marketing: A/B test idea: for paid cohort, benchmark at D8 vs D11, 10% holdout. Metrics: 7-day unsub delta, benchmark CTR, demo leads.
infra-bot: Deploy scheduled: marketing/campaigns/nurture-stagger-v1 at 2026-04-01T05:00:00Z (dry-run)
mira-campaigns: Implementation note for SendGrid payload (example): {"template_id":"tpl_bench_v2","vars":"delay_days=8","suppressions":"postlaunch_recent_engaged,sales_contacted"}
owen-analytics: I'll export suppression CSV and attach to the campaign doc. Expected net send drop ~14% for paid cohort.
kai-marketing: Owners: Emma (A/B + calendar), Mira (flows + staging), Owen (cohorts + export), Ben (sales flag check). Reconvene in #marketing-sync after dry-run. :thumbsup:
